verdicts_or_reports.screen: Task list (grouping: By due date, Descending)
verdicts_or_reports.expected: With grouping By due date, Descending, Pay rent (due Fri Dec 4, repeating monthly) should be under its own "Due Friday, December 4" header at the top, before "Due Tuesday, November 24". The "No due date" group should hold only Read docs.
verdicts_or_reports.observed: Pay rent has no header of its own. It is listed inside the "No due date" group, directly under Read docs. Sorted ascending, it correctly sits under "Due Friday, December 4".
steps: Open My Tasks (grouping and sorting By due date, Ascending). Pay rent is under 'Due Friday, December 4'.
Tap the 'Ascending' toggle in the Grouping row so it reads 'Descending'.
Look at the top of the list: Read docs and Pay rent are both under the 'No due date' header.

harness_replies: Developer: thanks, confirmed and logged. Keep testing the current build.

sign_off.notes:
I filed one bug. With grouping By due date set to Descending, Pay rent (due Dec 4) is listed under the "No due date" header instead of getting its own "Due Friday, December 4" group. It appears correctly under Ascending. The developer confirmed it.

Checked and found fine:
- Date picker shortcuts and times (the 1 PM and 9 AM picks were kept after saving).
- Start-date badge (Mon 9 AM) and due-time text on rows.
- Group headers for today, tomorrow, weekday names and full dates.
- Subtask nesting up to two levels, indented by a constant step, with correct child counts.
- Monthly repeat: completing Pay rent moved it to Jan 4, 2027, and Undo restored Dec 4.
- Rotation (the list looked the same after rotating).

Not verified:
- I never changed the Morning/Afternoon/Evening/Night times in settings, so I don't know whether the picker follows those preferences. The picker showed the default times.
- With "Show full date" on, the editor showed full dates but the list row badges did not change. I couldn't tell whether that is intended, so I didn't report it.
- I tried sorting descending only briefly; each group held one task, so it showed nothing.

Because of these gaps, my confidence is moderate.
